issue.body:
Hi

Thanks for creating the amazing libraries for BLE on Android, I am working on a production project to be released on playstore in early April & a bit confused between which BLE library `Android-BLE-Library` or `Kotlin-BLE-Library` to use in my project. I am tempted to use `Android-BLE-Library` since it has been battle tested earlier on prod projects by the community but also a bit skeptical regarding the upcoming support & maintenance for it.
